title: Analyzing data and numbers

body.text: Upload a table/spreadsheet and ask in plain language:
— great for people who aren't comfortable with Excel formulas but still need to read data well.

example: "From this monthly expense table, which category rose abnormally in the last 3 months, and what's the likely reason?"

title: From numbers to decisions

body.text: have the AI translate the numbers into business meaning and options
— not just 'sales down 12%' but 'down mainly from the new-customer segment; the options are A or B'.

example: "From this analysis, summarize the 3 things we should do next, with the pros and cons of each, to present to my boss"
